parts.name: Back cover
parts.what: the back of the case with the sensor window and the charging coil behind it
parts.feature: charging on the dock; IP68

parts.name: Charging coil
parts.what: wireless charging receiver coil, magnet-aligned with the dock
parts.feature: charging without a plug for older hands

parts.name: Sensor board
parts.what: the board against the skin: optical heart-rate sensor, skin temperature, off-body detection
parts.feature: heart rate at its own time; off-wrist; skin temperature trend (planned)

parts.name: PPG module
parts.what: the optical heart-rate sensor: green and red light through the window
parts.feature: heart-rate samples and the out-of-range alert

parts.name: Skin temperature sensor
parts.what: a contact thermometer beside the optical window
parts.feature: the daily report (planned)

parts.name: Battery
parts.what: about 400 mAh curved lithium-polymer cell for a day and a night on one charge
parts.feature: 24-hour wear; charged on the dock at the bedside

parts.name: Logic board
parts.what: the main board: system-on-chip with LTE and VoLTE, GNSS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, eSIM, power management, memory
parts.feature: runs the IRA CARE app, talks to the server, holds the outbox

parts.name: SoC and modem
parts.what: the wearable system-on-chip that runs AOSP and carries the LTE modem
parts.feature: the app, the conversation stream, calls to the circle

parts.name: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
parts.what: the Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth 5 radio for home use and pairing
parts.feature: readings upload at home; pairing

parts.name: GNSS
parts.what: the satellite receiver, asked for one position only when help is needed
parts.feature: the SOS carries where the person is

parts.name: eSIM
parts.what: the embedded SIM: the watch has its own line, no card to lose
parts.feature: LTE anywhere; VoLTE calls

parts.name: Power management
parts.what: charges the battery from the dock and feeds every rail
parts.feature: charging, battery notice to the carer

parts.name: Motion sensor
parts.what: 6-axis accelerometer and gyroscope at 50 Hz with a FIFO: the fall detectors read it
parts.feature: suspected fall (rule and trained model); movement after a missed check-in

parts.name: Barometer
parts.what: altitude change in the second before an impact (planned)
parts.feature: fall confidence

parts.name: Vibration motor
parts.what: a linear actuator: a firm pattern for a question, a fall, a carer's arrival
parts.feature: haptics channel of the communication profile

parts.name: Speaker
parts.what: a loud micro speaker behind the side grille
parts.feature: IRA speaks the question and the carer's name

parts.name: Microphones
parts.what: two noise-suppressing microphones, one each side, so IRA hears a quiet voice in a kitchen
parts.feature: Talk to IRA; the check-in answer; 'I'm OK' and 'help' by voice

parts.name: Display frame
parts.what: holds the display flat against the glass and seals the top of the case
parts.feature: IP68 sealing

parts.name: Display
parts.what: 1.39 inch round always-on display, 466 x 466: large words, the time, the carer coming
parts.feature: the home screen, the question, the fall countdown, 'Sravani is here'

parts.name: Cover glass
parts.what: sapphire-hard cover over the display, domed so a wet finger still slides
parts.feature: the whole screen; survives 24-hour wear and knocks

parts.name: Case
parts.what: 316L steel case, 46 mm, with two lugs for a 22 mm strap; the antenna runs in the slot
parts.feature: everything; LTE and GNSS antennas live in the case gap

parts.name: Bezel ring
parts.what: a raised ring the finger can feel, so the Help button is found by touch
parts.feature: orientation without looking

parts.name: Help button
parts.what: a large tactile button on the side, red, 11 mm long: one press tells the family and carers
parts.feature: Help request (SOS) with location

parts.name: Side button
parts.what: a smaller button: I'm OK, and the menu
parts.feature: I'm OK during a check-in or a fall countdown

parts.name: Strap
parts.what: medical-grade silicone, 22 mm, soft, with a magnetic clasp that closes itself
parts.feature: fastening with one hand or with arthritis

parts.name: Clasp
parts.what: the magnetic clasp: lay the two ends near each other and they close
parts.feature: fastening with one hand
